topic: null vs undefined check confusion — `if (x !== null)` letting undefined through
question: Quick reminder — what was the actual root cause?
butterfly_answer: `.toLowerCase()` was called on `handle` without checking if it existed first. The field was typed as optional (`handle?: string`) but the code assumed it was always present, so when it was `undefined`, the call threw a `TypeError`.
lastN_answer: The prior context doesn't include that — it picks up mid-conversation after the root cause discussion had already happened. I don't have it.
needle_fact: In `normalizeHandle` in src/components/UserProfile.tsx, the guard `if (handle !== null)` let `undefined` through because strict inequality `!==` against `null` does not cover `undefined`, so `.toLowerCase()` was called on `undefined`; the `Promise<any>` return type of `fetchUser` hid this from the type checker.
